title: Plotting Utilities for CCPS
text: ccpsplot provides R plotting utilities CCPS. Currently, provides two general utilities: minimalist ggplot theme (theme_ore()); color palettes ggplot scales use official CCPS “school board” colors.

title: Plotting Utilities for CCPS
text: can install development version ccpsplot Github :

title: Plotting Utilities for CCPS
text: Apply theme_ore() ggplot object usual fashion:
code: library(ggplot2) #> Warning: package 'ggplot2' was built under R version 4.5.3 library(ccpsplot)  ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg)) +     geom_point() +     labs(         title = "my awesome plot",         subtitle = "it's so cool",         caption = "it even has a caption"     ) +     theme_ore()

title: Plotting Utilities for CCPS
text: can apply custom ggplot color/fill palettes like :
code: z <- data.frame(     grp = c("a", "b", "c"),     x = 1:3,     y = 1:3 )  ggplot(z, aes(x, y, color = grp)) +     geom_point(size = 5) +     scale_color_schoolboard() ggplot(z, aes(grp, y, fill = grp)) +     geom_col() +     scale_fill_schoolboard()

title: Theme ORE — theme_ore
text: size Numeric. Base font size. Default 12. base_font Character. Base font family. Default 'sans' base_color Character. Color text ticks. Default 'grey20' accent_color Character. Color grid lines. Default 'grey40'. faceted Logical. TRUE reduce margins make faceted subplots larger
